title: FIL Samples To Frame
text: Convert sample stream from FPGA-in-the-loop to frame-based data, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Number of input samples} sets the number of values representing each sample, {Output size} sets the maximum samples per frame, {Compose output from interleaved input samples} sets the order of output samples relative to input and {Enable frame length output port} sets the output number of valid samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: frame
ports.summary: Frame of output samples column vector

ports.name: len
ports.summary: Number of valid samples in output frame integer

params.name: Number of input samples
params.values: Number of values representing each sample 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output size
params.values: Maximum samples per frame 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Compose output from interleaved input samples
params.values: Order of output samples relative to input order off (default) | on

params.name: Enable frame length output port
params.values: Output number of valid samples off (default) | on
